summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting periodic buyback activity under its Euro 3.5 billion multi-year share buyback program, second tranche of Euro 250 million. The filing discloses daily purchases on EXM and NYSE from June 22–26, 2026, with total consideration of ~€19.1 million for 62,641 shares. Prices averaged ~€305 per share on EXM. The company held 9.28% of issued common shares in treasury as of June 26. Buybacks are authorized through 2030, with treasury shares pending cancellation approved at the April 15, 2026 AGM. Watch for ongoing repurchase pace and share count reduction effects.
